rules.statement: The continuity of possession is broken when a court decision interrupts the adverse possession, but this does not necessarily bar the possessor from claiming under prescription if they can establish other elements such as intent and duration.
rules.supporting_quote: "Another essential requisite to constitute such an adverse possession as will be of efficacy under the statute is continuity; and whether a possession is 'undisturbed and uninterrupted' depends much upon the circumstances. If the continuity of possession is broken before the expiration of the period of time limited by the statute, the seisin of the true owner is restored; in such a case to gain a title under the statute 326 a new adverse possession for the time limited must be had."
